State: SHUTDOWN | Valve Command Pattern (V1,V2,V3): 0,1,1 | Definition / Exit Condition: V1 closed; V2 and V3 commanded open together. Remain in SHUTDOWN until both tanks are at or below their low-level limits, then close all valves and go to IDLE.

State: IDLE | Valve Command Pattern (V1,V2,V3): 0,0,0 | Definition / Exit Condition: All valves closed. A START edge begins FILL_T1. A SHUT command while already empty has no useful hydraulic effect and may be treated as completed shutdown.
State: FILL_T1 | Valve Command Pattern (V1,V2,V3): 1,0,0 | Definition / Exit Condition: Command XV-101 open. XV-102 and XV-103 closed. Transition when LT-101 >= T1_High.
State: WAIT_AFTER_FILL | Valve Command Pattern (V1,V2,V3): 0,0,0 | Definition / Exit Condition: All valves closed. Hold for the configured post-fill wait. STOP freezes remaining time.
State: TRANSFER_T1_T2 | Valve Command Pattern (V1,V2,V3): 0,1,0 | Definition / Exit Condition: Command XV-102 open. V1 and V3 closed. Transition when LT-101 <= T1_Low.
State: WAIT_AFTER_TRANSFER | Valve Command Pattern (V1,V2,V3): 0,0,0 | Definition / Exit Condition: All valves closed. Hold for configured post-transfer wait. STOP freezes remaining time.
State: DRAIN_T2 | Valve Command Pattern (V1,V2,V3): 0,0,1 | Definition / Exit Condition: Command XV-103 open. V1 and V2 closed. Transition when LT-102 <= T2_Low.
State: WAIT_AFTER_DRAIN | Valve Command Pattern (V1,V2,V3): 0,0,0 | Definition / Exit Condition: All valves closed. Hold for inter-cycle wait, then return to FILL_T1 automatically.

State: PAUSED | Valve Command Pattern (V1,V2,V3): 0,0,0 | Definition / Exit Condition: All valves closed. Preserve the interrupted sequence state and, if applicable, its remaining timer. START resumes the stored state.
From: PAUSED | Trigger / Guard: START edge | To: stored state | Actions: restore state outputs | Comment: resume
From: any non-shutdown | Trigger / Guard: SHUT edge | To: SHUTDOWN | Actions: V1=0,V2=1,V3=1 | Comment: clear resume context
From: SHUTDOWN | Trigger / Guard: LT-101 <= T1_Low AND LT-102 <= T2_Low | To: IDLE | Actions: V2=0,V3=0 | Comment: shutdown complete
From: IDLE | Trigger / Guard: START edge | To: FILL_T1 | Actions: V1=1 | Comment: new cycle
From: FILL_T1 | Trigger / Guard: LT-101 >= T1_High | To: WAIT_AFTER_FILL | Actions: V1=0; start timer
From: WAIT_AFTER_FILL | Trigger / Guard: timer expired | To: TRANSFER_T1_T2 | Actions: V2=1
From: TRANSFER_T1_T2 | Trigger / Guard: LT-101 <= T1_Low | To: WAIT_AFTER_TRANSFER | Actions: V2=0; start timer
From: WAIT_AFTER_TRANSFER | Trigger / Guard: timer expired | To: DRAIN_T2 | Actions: V3=1
From: DRAIN_T2 | Trigger / Guard: LT-102 <= T2_Low | To: WAIT_AFTER_DRAIN | Actions: V3=0; start timer
From: WAIT_AFTER_DRAIN | Trigger / Guard: timer expired | To: FILL_T1 | Actions: V1=1 | Comment: automatic repeat
From: normal/wait | Trigger / Guard: STOP edge | To: PAUSED | Actions: all valves 0 | Comment: store state + remaining wait
